headline: Canucks claim Cameron Crotty off waivers from Wild
take: Daily Faceoff reports Vancouver claimed defenseman Cameron Crotty off waivers from Minnesota, with the Canucks having lost 16 of their last 17 after Monday's loss to Philadelphia. Crotty has played three NHL games this season at about 11 minutes a night, so this is a depth move, not a fix. The fix would have to be bigger than anyone can claim on waivers: Vancouver is 3-16-1, with 39.9% of the expected goals (the quality of chances), and its goaltending has allowed 14.8 goals more than expected. A team in that spot claims bodies to get through the schedule. The more interesting question is what the front office does next, and how soon.
